title: federation-00: add Peer/* request/response examples
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 prints no example request or response for any Peer/* method (Peer/deliver incl. edit/reaction/retract, Peer/receipt, Peer/typing, Peer/groupUpdate, presence) and no error example; those sections define fields in prose only. The only examples are the discovery GET /.well-known/jmap Session and the peerSigningKeys JSON. Implementations therefore have no independent oracle for the Peer/* wire format: chinwag's federation tests only prove chinwag agrees with itself (chinwag-nuqe.7.10, nuqe.7.26, nuqe.7.27). Add one full signed-request + response example per method, plus one error example (e.g. forbidden for an unknown recipientUserId). Filed from chinwag 2026-10-30 at Mark's request.
